// coding-misk · Drift
// song composed with sections and tracks: each track plays its clips, switched on by the section lane (1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade)
// each .analyze("…") lights up its instrument in the Stage visual
setcpm(128/4)

const SECTIONS = [['Crescendo', 24], ['Crescendo 2', 40], ['Intro', 4], ['Drop', 16], ['Break', 4], ['Drop 2', 16], ['Outro', 3], ['Colpo', 1]]
const TEMPO = {'Crescendo': 128, 'Crescendo 2': 128, 'Intro': 128, 'Drop': 128, 'Break': 128, 'Drop 2': 128, 'Outro': 128, 'Colpo': 128}

// section lanes: 1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade
const section1 = "<1!24 0!84>"  // Crescendo · 24 bars · 128 BPM · F# · F#m
const section2 = "<0!24 1!40 0!44>"  // Crescendo 2 · 40 bars · 128 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section3 = "<0!64 1!4 0!40>"  // Intro · 4 bars · 128 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section4 = "<0!68 1!16 0.5 0!23>"  // Drop · 16 bars · 128 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section5 = "<0!84 0.5 1!3 0!20>"  // Break · 4 bars · 128 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E · fades in over 1 bars
const section6 = "<0!88 1!16 0!4>"  // Drop 2 · 16 bars · 128 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section7 = "<0!104 1!3 0>"  // Outro · 3 bars · 128 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section8 = "<0!107 1>"  // Colpo · 1 bars · 128 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E

// ========== drums ==========
// Crescendo · bars 1-24 · pattern A~1
// Drums · RolandTR808
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ bd] [~ ~ bd ~] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.95).distort(1.5).distortvol(.5).crush(13).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [cp ~ ~ ~] ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.76).distort(1.5).distortvol(.5).crush(13).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
